channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Hermes Birkin bags built their reputation on rarity, but shifting resale demand is changing the conversation
item.description: The Hermes Birkin bag is losing some of its scarcity-driven appeal as second-hand supply grows and resale prices fall from pandemic-era highs. The shift is putting pressure on a luxury business model built around exclusivity, demand and high resale premiums.

item.title: How Sonu Sood leasing Mumbai site to coffee giant for ₹3.52 cr over 5 yrs secured high passive commercial yields
item.description: Actor Sonu Sood has leased a commercial property in Mumbai’s Versova to Bokka Coffee in a five-year deal worth ₹3.52 crore. Monthly rent starts at ₹5 lakh and rises by around 8% annually, according to property registration documents.

item.title: UAE: Ras Al Khaimah closes all beaches after offshore oil spill
item.description: Closures follow similar measures in Umm Al Quwain and Sharjah; authorities assess environmental impact of oil leak

item.title: Storm Boelo batters UK, disrupts travel and leaves 82,000 homes without power
item.description: Strong winds and flooding hit Scotland, Northern Ireland and northern England; storm also disrupts flights and ferry services across northern Europe

item.title: From the French Revolution to Yellow Vests: Why protest is embedded in France’s political history amid nationwide unrest
item.description: France’s latest unrest reflects a long history of mass mobilisation, from the 1789 French Revolution and the Paris Commune to May 1968 and the Yellow Vests movement. As protests over living costs and public services intensify, the streets remain a key arena for political dissent.

item.title: Brazil polls: President Lula da Silva gets 1st smartphone at 80, but can he catch up with Brazil’s digital generation?
item.description: Brazilian President Lula da Silva has got his first smartphone at 80 as he steps up social media campaigning ahead of the presidential runoff. With digital-savvy rivals gaining ground, can the veteran leader connect with Brazil’s younger voters?

item.title: India-EU FTA signing targeted for December 17–18 during PM Modi’s expected Brussels visit - Report
item.description: The European Commission has reportedly urged the Council of the European Union, which represents the bloc’s 27 member states, to approve the FTA through a fast-track procedure.

item.title: Woman works 18 hours a day but still earns half her husband's salary: Viral video sparks overwork, pay disparity debate
item.description: A 29-year-old Korea-based content creator, Rebecca, has sparked an online debate after sharing a reel documenting what she describes as a typical 18-hour workday. Her routine has prompted viewers to question the sustainability of long working hours.

item.title: From ₹5 disinfectant to ₹11,800 LED bulbs: Why Madhya Pradesh civic purchases face Lokayukta scrutiny
item.description: The Lokayukta probe is expected to examine purchase orders, invoices and vendor details. Civic officials now face closer scrutiny over how public funds were spent on basic items such as lights, vehicles and disinfectants.

item.title: Who is Bibha Chowdhuri? Indian physicist who studied cosmic rays and had a star named in her honour
item.description: Bibha Chowdhuri was a pioneering Indian physicist who researched cosmic rays, published in Nature and became one of India's first women in high-energy physics. Decades after her death, a star was named Bibha in her honour.

item.title: Neil Armstrong’s childhood home saved by ₹3.8 cr donation: Restoration plans, tourist opening targeted for 2030
item.description: A $400,000 donation from retired military and commercial airline pilot Ken Schreiber helped the Auglaize County Historical Society acquire Neil Armstrong’s childhood home in Ohio.&nbsp;

item.title: Ashwini Vaishnaw sets October 2028 deadline for smartphones designed, manufactured, branded in India: What he said
item.description: Ashwini Vaishnaw has set October 23, 2028, as the target for India to have smartphones designed, manufactured and branded domestically. The ambition comes as the country seeks to move beyond manufacturing devices for global companies and build its own design capabilities and intellectual property.

item.title: Karnataka CM warns Bengaluru's IT companies over alleged bias against Kannadigas: What triggered his statement?
item.description: Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar warned private firms of action if they deliberately deny jobs to Kannadigas. His statement followed a viral video alleging Bengaluru IT companies favour Telugu and Tamil speakers over Kannada-speaking candidates, reigniting debate over jobs for locals.

item.title: Who is Rashesh Upadhyay? What's the cyber fraud, digital arrest case against him? How was he caught by the ED? Explained
item.description: Rashesh Upadhyay, also known as Rashesh Shah, has been arrested by the Enforcement Directorate in a money-laundering probe into an alleged nationwide cyber fraud and digital arrest network. The case involves ₹28,000 crore in banking transactions, with seven arrests so far.

item.title: Who is Dr Ashokkumar Veeramuthu? Nilgiris researcher turning waste into wealth earns global recognition
item.description: From government schools in Tamil Nadu’s Nilgiris district to international research collaborations, Dr Ashokkumar Veeramuthu has featured in Stanford–Elsevier global scientist rankings for four consecutive years.

item.title: Protect banking system from cyber looters, cyber terrorists: PM Modi
item.description: Inaugurating the RBI’s new data centre and cybersecurity training institute in Bhubaneswar, PM Modi said the next decade will focus on making Indian banking more efficient and reliable after expanding access to millions over the past 10 years.

item.title: ‘You all saw it’: Voter calls out Zohran Mamdani for ‘jumping queue’ at NYC early voting site | WATCH
item.description: A video shows Mamdani, accompanied by a bodyguard, walking past a voter towards a booth, prompting the man to object and confront the mayor’s security detail.

item.title: US midterms 2026: Political ad spending tops $10 billion — where is the money coming from and what is driving the surge?
item.description: US political ad spending for the 2026 midterm elections has crossed $10 billion and is projected to hit $11.6 billion by Election Day, setting a new record. Republicans are outspending Democrats in key Senate and House races.

item.title: IndiGo, Air India clear runway for shift to Navi Mumbai airport
item.description: Together, the country's two largest airlines are expected to handle nearly 3 million passengers from the Navi Mumbai airport, accounting for about 60% of the traffic affected by the proposed transition, the person said.

item.title: Delhi’s longest cycling track planned along Yamuna: Route details, opening date, cost and purpose
item.description: The route forms part of a larger 52-km Yamuna corridor planned to be developed in three phases.

item.title: Iran’s alleged lethal plots against US in ‘advance’ stage: Is the Houthi threat spreading? What US intel memo reveals
item.description: The warning, issued by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, comes as the US State Department reduces personnel at several American diplomatic missions across the Middle East amid concerns about a wider regional conflict.

item.title: Elon Musk announces $1 tipping on X in US: How the new X Money payment option will work
item.description: Elon Musk says X will introduce a feature allowing users to send $1 to another person by long-pressing the Like button. The move could simplify creator tipping as X expands its financial services through X Money.

item.title: Why is the UK asking citizens to stockpile food and water? Cyberattacks, extreme weather among key concerns - Rationale
item.description: The UK is urging households to prepare for three days of disruption under its ‘Be Ready’ campaign. What prompted the advice, and what should residents keep at home?

item.title: Cyclone Arnab: Depression over Bay of Bengal to intensify; when and where will landfall occur? IMD's latest updates
item.description: IMD forecast Cyclone Arnab to intensify into very severe cyclonic storm and make landfall near the Andhra coast on Oct 28, bringing heavy rain and strong winds to parts of Andhra and Odisha. Both states reviewed preparations and directed officials to protect residents in low-lying areas.

item.title: 4.2 magnitude earthquake jolts Nepal's Baitadi, tremors felt in nearby districts; no reports of damage so far
item.description: An earthquake struck Nepal’s Baitadi district, following two quakes in neighbouring Tibet this week. The latest seismic activity comes as rescue teams and displaced residents grapple with the aftermath of Thursday’s deadly quake.

item.title: Audi to invest $4.2 billion in first US factory, plans to build 2 lakh SUVs annually
item.description: Audi plans to invest $4.2 billion in its first US factory in Georgia, targeting annual production of 2 lakh SUVs and creating around 4,500 jobs. Construction is expected to begin in 2027, with production scheduled to start in the early 2030s.

item.title: Who is Ravi Tamta? Uttarakhand man develops electric flying car in Almora; check his other inventions
item.description: Uttarakhand innovator Ravi Tamta spent 13 years developing HAPIDA SKYNeX, an electric flying car designed to take off and land vertically without a runway.&nbsp;

item.title: RIP Chef Damu: From dishwasher to respected name of culinary world - Top facts about Cooku with Comali judge Damordaran
item.description: Chef Damu, the Padma Shri-winning chef and Cooku with Comali judge, died at 72 after a period of ill health. Known for promoting Tamil cuisine, he held three Guinness records, authored cookbooks, and trained thousands of cooks, including workers in Tamil Nadu’s midday-meal scheme.

item.title: From France to Italy, what protests mean for Europe’s $187 bn winter tourism industry ahead of Christmas-New Year season
item.description: Protests across France over economic pressures have turned violent, with authorities reporting nearly 1,000 arrests. The unrest threatens to disrupt France’s winter tourism season, as foreign governments issue travel advisories and reports indicate hotel bookings are being cancelled.

item.title: ₹1 cr annual salary package: With AI growth, MNC demand, this job is set to become highest-paid engineer role in India
item.description: A Scaler-CMR report says demand for Forward Deployed Engineers in India is expected to grow, with 88% of enterprises anticipating increased need by 2030. Engineers in explicit FDE roles report annual incomes ranging from ₹40 lakh to ₹1 crore.

item.title: ISRO to expand space ops, plans 4 launch pads by 2029, says Narayanan as he clarifies the agency will not be privatised
item.description: ISRO chief V Narayanan said India will have four functional launch pads by 2029, backed by private partnerships. He outlined plans for the Kulasekarapattinam SSLV spaceport, uncrewed Gaganyaan tests and Chandrayaan-5, a joint mission with Japan featuring a 350-kg rover.

item.title: Scammers trick older people into leaving gold in forests, public places; should you be worried? Here’s how to stay safe
item.description: Scammers are persuading people, often older adults, to buy gold and leave it outside for collection, promising safe storage and high returns.&nbsp;

item.title: How Tamil Nadu CM Vijay got rare praise from Modi govt: Big step he took on aviation fuel
item.description: Vijay government implemented steep tax cuts on ATF that will remain in force for one year, until 31 October 2027.

item.title: Tamil Nadu's favourite Chef Damu passes away at 72; here's all you need to know about ‘Cooku with Comali’ judge
item.description: Padma Shri awardee Chef Damodharan, popularly known as Chef Damu, passed away on Sunday at the age of 72 after a period of ill health. He was widely recognised for his culinary work and his role as a judge on the Tamil television show Cooku with Comali.

item.title: Sourav Ganguly vs ‘Doosra’: Delhi HC seeks filmmaker's response over cricketer's personality rights plea; what we know
item.description: The Delhi High Court has sought a response from the makers of “Doosra” to Sourav Ganguly’s personality rights plea and ordered a screening. Ganguly alleges unauthorised commercial use of his persona. The filmmakers deny infringement. The next hearing is on 29 October.
